ideas.pitch: A localized stablecoin payment and automated merchant settlement web app tailored for digital nomad hubs and street vendors in Chiang Mai.
ideas.title: NomadStablePay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the PayFi & RWA track (3,000 USDT) and the Cosmo-Localism bonus track (1,000 USDT) by solving real-world payment friction for merchants in Chiang Mai.

ideas.pitch: An AI health companion integrated with local wearable data to track sleep patterns, hydration, and local tropical biohacking routines.
ideas.title: ThaiLongevityAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the open, product-focused Longevity track without forcing a complex Web3 requirement, leveraging proven AI nutrition and health coaching architecture.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge health data locker that allows digital nomads to prove vaccination status or blood panel thresholds to local wellness centers without revealing raw data.
ideas.title: ZKVitaMask
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting Privacy & Data Sovereignty, this gives judges a tangible ZK implementation combined with health data sovereignty, which is rare and highly valued in hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A cross-border QR stablecoin remittance and payment tool optimized for Southeast Asian night market vendors accepting payments from international nomads.
ideas.title: LannaNightMarketPay
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines PayFi & RWA with the Cosmo-Localism bonus track by solving a genuine local commerce challenge in Southeast Asia with a working demo.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI health workflow that analyzes wearable sleep data and automatically schedules restorative biohacking sessions or local supplement deliveries in Chiang Mai.
ideas.title: SleeperAgentAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leans heavily into the Longevity track by coupling an AI health companion with actionable local services, focusing on a robust, working end-to-end demo.
